$Comment: The yearly feast: once the questline is done, bring the host a pumpkin pie, some cooked meat and
carrots, and sit down to the feast. Its pay holds that year's keepsake, Martha's Golden Plate
(Item/Items/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Golden_Plate.json) with the year on it, collected with the
rest at the host. The first Claim row is the plate: StackNameArg @run reads as the label of the
Harvest Feast run this quest is paid for, which for a yearly event is its year, and StackNameKey,
keepsake.harvest_feast_golden_plate.name, is stamped into every plate handed over and read back from
the item, so never rename that key, nor keepsake.harvest_feast_plate.name, which names the game's
plates players already hold. Finishing it also earns that year's keepsake achievement,
harvest_feast_keepsake, for its points.
Collecting it rolls Harvest_Feast_Feast_Pay, whose always-paying roll hands over the leftovers
the three supper deliveries offered next (Supper_Tomas.json, Supper_Elsie.json and Supper_Bram.json)
take round, and cues the celebration moment
Harvest_Feast_Feast_Served.
Repeat.PerRun brings this one quest back once in each year's run of Harvest Feast: a run pays it
once, a forced or moved run cannot pay it twice, and a feast left unfinished when the run ends waits
for next year and counts for that year's run. The steps before it never come back. Everything here
is handed in at the host, so no report-back step is added.
The two Mmo_Xp rows are MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP for the cooking and Harvesting XP for the
carrots, waiting to be collected with the rest. Each row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed
gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: The_Feast
